detail.longDescription: There have been some interest for networking tools lately (pcap analyzers, iperf) so let me introduce you to Crafty, a network investigation tool designed for LLM: like Scapy, but safe (and also: better). There is an associated benchmark where you can compare the efficiency of various tools, including Scapy and Crafty: https://github.com/CloudyWithAChanceOfLatency/robibench Work in progress etc, comments and ideas welcomed.
